primitives.name: Holiday Baseline Standard
primitives.verbatim_quote: Project Holiday Schedule Defines the client-facing holiday baseline and shared observance dates across the JV.
primitives.assumptions: All JV partners observe identical client-facing holidays; baseline is fixed and non-negotiable.

primitives.name: Morning Operational Timing
primitives.verbatim_quote: Daily Start Standard Daily Stretch & Flex begins at 6:00 a.m.
primitives.assumptions: Operational timing is uniform across all partners; flexibility is bounded by fixed start time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deviation from 6:00 a.m. start impacts inter-partner coordination and project alignment.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's temporal state machine where 6:00 a.m. is a deterministic kernel for daily operational phase initiation.

primitives.name: Fair Coverage Allocation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Critical Coverage & Rotation Coverage is planned, limited, approved, and rotated fairly across partners.
primitives.assumptions: Coverage is equitably distributed among partners; rotation is pre-approved and tracked.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Unapproved or unfair rotation causes operational imbalance or partner dissatisfaction.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSI's fair-share allocation algorithm where coverage is modeled as a resource partitioning problem across partners.
